title: Graphic Design
shortDescription: Learn visual design, branding and layout with industry tools.
description: A practical program covering design principles, typography, colour theory and brand identity. Students build a portfolio of posters, social media creatives, logos and print layouts using professional design software.
syllabus: Photoshop for photo editing and composition
Illustrator for logos and vector art
Brand identity and social media design

title: Web Development
shortDescription: Build responsive websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
description: Start from the basics of the web and build responsive, accessible websites. The course covers HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, Grid, JavaScript fundamentals and deploying a static website.
syllabus: Final website project and hosting basics

title: AI & Machine Learning
shortDescription: Understand machine learning concepts and build simple models with Python.
description: An introduction to artificial intelligence and machine learning using Python. Learn data handling, supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation and build small real-world projects.

title: Video Editing
shortDescription: Edit professional videos, reels and promos with modern editing tools.
description: Learn the full video editing workflow: importing footage, cutting, colour correction, audio mixing, titles, motion graphics basics and exporting for YouTube, Instagram and client delivery.

title: Digital Marketing
shortDescription: Master SEO, social media, ads and email marketing strategies.
description: A complete digital marketing program covering search engine optimisation, social media marketing, paid advertising, content marketing, email campaigns and analytics to grow a business online.
syllabus: Social media marketing and content planning
Google Ads and social media advertising

title: Tally Prime
shortDescription: Learn accounting, GST and inventory management using Tally Prime.
description: A job-oriented accounting course that teaches company creation, vouchers, ledgers, inventory, GST, TDS and financial reports using Tally Prime with real-world business examples.

title: Data Analytics
shortDescription: Turn raw data into insights using Excel, SQL and Power BI.
description: Learn to collect, clean, analyse and visualise data. The course covers advanced Excel, SQL queries, dashboard design with Power BI and presenting insights to stakeholders.

title: Full Stack Development
shortDescription: Become a complete developer with front-end, back-end and databases.
description: An advanced program for building complete web applications. Learn React, Node.js, REST APIs, databases and deployment while working on team-style projects.
syllabus: REST API design and authentication concepts
